name: Everglades Youth Conservation Camp Leadership Camp
org: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC), Everglades Youth Conservation Center
what_you_do: Spend a week at an overnight nature camp. You get hands-on work and mentoring that prepare you for future jobs at summer camps and parks. Earn up to 40 service-learning credits.
pay_detail: The camp lists programs from $400 to $515 per week. The Leadership Camp price is not listed separately on the program page.
deadline_text: Camp runs through June and July, with weekly check-in on Sundays. Application dates for the Leadership Camp were not stated.
how_to_apply: Use the Camp Registration Portal linked from the camp page, or call the camp at 561-624-6929.
notes: Paid camp staff jobs at this center need you to be at least 19, so this camp is the teen route. Address: 12100 Seminole Pratt Whitney Road, West Palm Beach, FL.
